decisions.reason: The initial nonempty hypothesis makes the obstruction sound, but the separately quantified final clause says every closed n-manifold, including the empty one. Its unique formal datum is holonomic. Binding both occurrences to this nonempty M removes the inconsistent universal wording; the compact clopen image proof itself remains valid.

The formal-immersion definition assumes AC_omega for the canonical smooth tangent bundles, and the weak-topology definition assumes it for mapping spaces on TM and TN. The original space definition invokes both total-space constructions unconditionally. Added exactly this supplier hypothesis and its dependency; the subspace and projection constructions require no further choice.

Fibrewise injectivity of F does not imply that df has full rank: the constant map S^1 to R^2 with a nonzero formal tangent column is a counterexample. The proof now fixes an arbitrary genuine immersion for (i), then independently fixes a formal pair for (ii) and computes its own matrix minor margins. Compact finite chart pieces and C1 control prove (i); compact vectors (x,e_j) and C0 column control prove (ii). The tangent-total-space topology also carries its actual AC_omega hypothesis.

The cited relative-homotopy definition fixes H(a,t) separately for each a; it does not require one common value on A times I. The stationary identity homotopy on R with A={0,1} satisfies that interface and violates the original parenthetical. Replaced it by the exact pointwise equation, and made formal relative homotopies fix the base and fibre maps. Countable choice is carried only for the associated tangent-bundle mapping spaces.

Step 10.1 originally changed only an inner disk, while the asserted endpoint was holonomic on all of the open U, including other components. The repair retains that global conclusion: after integrating an enlarged disk, it exhausts U by regular compact sublevels and integrates every finite band with full source rank k. Every handle index j<=k<n satisfies the already proved core integration hypothesis. Stage deformations extend with source time cutoffs, freeze preceding open neighbourhoods, and have an eventually stationary limit on each compact set. Least candidates in fixed dense countable correction families avoid dependent choice.

The frozen disk Statement only named rank-k disks, but its Proof 5.1-8.1 already proved the full-m-column core comparison, attaching-germ realization, and positive cocore compression used here. Thus the mathematical construction was present; the contract cited only an interface that did not state it. The supplier now states these claims as (iii), and (iv) supplies the compact-A relative parameter transfer used in 3.1. Updated F2 to these exact clauses; no source dimension or rank hypothesis is dropped.

An ambient basis element can meet two different band components, so the original least-meeting-member rule was not injective. Every positive-dimensional band component has a nonempty ambient interior. Indexing it by the least basis member contained in that interior is injective within each band, because component interiors are disjoint. Pairing with the band index proves countability and licenses the independent AC_omega selection of complete finite presentations. The geometric triad and dual-elimination proof is unchanged.

The genuine smoothing suppliers require compact source M; the original F3 and 5.1 applied them to arbitrary noncompact M. Added an explicit noncompact parameter-smoothing proof in 1.3: locally finite source partitions with supportwise convolution radii control both first-derivative errors and the d(lambda_j) value-error terms beneath a pointwise immersion tolerance. Tubular retraction preserves full rank, and parameter-only cutoffs fix neighbourhood-smooth relative data. Disk boundary HEP and a genuine annulus then give injectivity for the original unsmoothed families. The compatible exhaustion proof still proves the same weak-equivalence and relative claims under AC_omega.

The zero matrix defines a smooth bundle map of trivial equal-rank bundles but is outside GL_m for m>=1, so L2 omitted the injectivity qualification. Fixed frames identify all bundle maps with smooth matrix-valued maps, and precisely the fibrewise injective ones with GL_m-valued maps. The actual construction in 1.1 is an isomorphism and the subsequent open-source theorem applies with AC_omega, so the example conclusion is unchanged.

The frozen disk Statement described boundaryless smooth parameter families, whereas this theorem needed neighbourhood-pair transfer for an ordinary derivative weak equivalence on compact closed sources and parameters with interval factors. Disk Proof 9.1 contained that transfer mechanism but its contract did not expose the general compact-source clause. It is now precisely Statement (iv), with the finite pair, collar HEP, and compact genuine smoothing proof in 13.1. F3 and 4.1 now cite that clause with X compact; noncompact components use the open-source theorem. The enriched normal-identification descent was checked against the actual restriction and forgetful-fibration constructions.

Consumed space/geometry in the claim: The $n$-torus $T^n=S^1\times\cdots\times S^1$ admits formal immersions into $\mathbb R^n$ for every $n\ge1$: it is a product of circles, the standard angular fields give a global frame of $TT^n\cong T^n\times\mathbb R^n$, and the identity bundle map is fibrewise injective. Yet no nonempty closed $n$-manifold — in particular not $T^n$ — admits an immersion into $\mathbb R^n$. Thus the rank data $TM\oplus\nu\cong\varepsilon^n$ with $\nu$ of rank zero is formally plausible but geometrically impossible, and the equidimensional closed-source case genuinely needs the positive-codimension hypothesis; the Smale–Hirsch theorem is not contradicted, because its closed-source form requires $m<n$.

consumer_examinations.affected_use:
Declared dependency on def-space-of-immersions-and-space-of-formal-immersions; no body wikilink. Consumed space/geometry in the claim: Assume $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$. Let $m<n$, let $M$ be a compact smooth boundaryless $m$-manifold and let $N^n$ be smooth and boundaryless. The derivative map induces a bijection
$$\{\text{regular homotopy classes of immersions }M\to N\}\longleftrightarrow\{\text{homotopy classes of formal immersions }M\to N\}.$$
Thus two immersions are regularly homotopic if and only if their formal derivatives are homotopic through formal immersions. For every finite CW pair $(P,Q)$ and a fixed genuine family on $Q$, derivative induces a bijection between relative homotopy classes of continuous $P$-families of genuine and formal immersions with that prescribed restriction.
